faq_heading: Langley houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Langley houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 89 of 777, or 11%. A further 121 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Langley?
faq.a: $1,378,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $1,175,000 and $1,600,000.

faq.q: Which Langley area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Aldergrove Langley, at $1,025,000 across 86 sales at $479 a square foot, median year built 1981. The tenth lowest was Willoughby Heights at $1,470,000.

faq.q: How fast do Langley houses sell?
faq.a: 22 days at the median, closing at 96.9% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Langley, 89 of the 777 houses (11%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $1,378,000, with the middle half between $1,175,000 and $1,600,000. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 297 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Langley

In Aldergrove Langley the median house sold for $1,025,000 across 86 sales, $25,000 over $1,000,000. Across Langley the median house took 22 days to sell and closed at 96.9% of the last list price, with 6% of the 777 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
